title: Pure Burning Abyss
summary: Burning Abyss cards only, paired with hand traps and an automatic Extra Deck. The Malebranche are Level 3 DARK Fiends that Special Summon themselves from the hand while you control no Spells or Traps and trigger a unique effect whenever they are sent to the GY from anywhere.

summary.title: Starters & The Graff-Cir-Scarm Core
points: Graff, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss Special Summons a Burning Abyss monster from the Deck whenever it is sent to the GY.
Cir, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss revives a Burning Abyss monster from the GY whenever it is sent to the GY, forming an endless recursion loop with Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss.
Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss searches any Level 3 DARK Fiend from the Deck during the End Phase of the turn it was sent to the GY.

Libic, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss Special Summons a Level 3 DARK Fiend from the hand with its effects negated on the field, letting you deploy another Malebranche alongside non-Burning Abyss monsters without it self-destructing.

summary.title: Opening: Any Two Malebranche Monsters
steps: With no Spells or Traps on your field, Special Summon one Malebranche from the hand and Normal Summon a second.
Overlay into Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss and detach a material to mill 3 cards (ideally hitting Graff, Scarm, or Cagna), or Link Summon Cherubini, Ebon Angel of the Burning Abyss.

Send Graff from the Deck to the GY as cost for Cherubini's effect; Graff Special Summons Cir from the Deck into a zone Cherubini points to, setting up a second Dante or Fire Lake of the Burning Abyss.

summary.title: Self-Destruction Rule & Spell-Free Main Deck
summary.text: Every Main Deck Malebranche can only Special Summon itself from the hand while you control no Spell or Trap Cards, and it immediately destroys itself on the field if you control a monster that is not a Burning Abyss monster. Because of those two rules, the Main Deck fill package uses only hand traps and zero staple Spells, while Cherubini, Ebon Angel of the Burning Abyss prevents any monster it points to from being destroyed by card effects, including the Malebranche's own self-destruction effect.

summary.title: Bosses & GY Disruption
points: Dante, Traveler of the Burning Abyss mills up to 3 cards as cost to gain up to 1500 ATK, switches to Defense Position after attacking, and adds a Burning Abyss card from the GY to the hand whenever it is sent to the GY (looping endlessly with Cir).
Cherubini, Ebon Angel of the Burning Abyss sends any Level 3 monster from the Deck to the GY as cost to boost ATK, meaning its mill cannot be negated by Ash Blossom.

Farfa, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss banishes a monster on the field until the End Phase when sent to the GY, Alich negates a face-up monster's effects, Calcab bounces a Set Spell/Trap, and Barbar banishes up to 3 Burning Abyss cards from the GY for up to 900 burn damage.

Virgil, Rock Star of the Burning Abyss (made with Rubic) discards a Burning Abyss card to shuffle an opposing field or GY card into the Deck, while Dante, Pilgrim of the Burning Abyss and Malacoda, Netherlord of the Burning Abyss provide untargetable draw power and Quick Effect stat reduction.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left Out
points: Fire Lake of the Burning Abyss sends 2 face-up Burning Abyss monsters you control to the GY to destroy up to 3 cards on the field, while triggering the GY effects of the sent monsters.

The Traveler and the Burning Abyss Special Summons any number of Burning Abyss monsters that were sent to the GY that turn, and Good & Evil in the Burning Abyss banishes itself from the GY to search any Burning Abyss card.
Beatrice, Lady of the Eternal is excluded because it is Forbidden in the TCG.
